events.region: Lake Michigan from North Point Light to Wind Point WI 5NM offshore to Mid Lake; Lake Michigan from Wind Point WI to Winthrop Harbor IL 5NM offshore to Mid Lake
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
For the following areas...
Lake Michigan from North Point Light WI to Winthrop Harbor IL 5 nm
off shore to mid lake...

At 500 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing waterspouts
was located 26 nm east of Wind Pt., moving south at 30 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts 34 knots or greater, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.

events.region: Clay, IL; Effingham, IL; Jasper, IL
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SVRILX

The National Weather Service in Lincoln has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Western Jasper County in southeastern Illinois...
North central Clay County in south central Illinois...
Eastern Effingham County in south central Illinois...

* Until 545 AM CDT.

* At 501 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Dieterich, or
10 miles southeast of Effingham, moving south at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Wheeler around 505 AM CDT.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 57 between mile markers 162 and 164.
Interstate 70 between mile markers 96 and 104.

This also includes Newton Lake State Fish and Wildlife Area.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Hamilton County in south central Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 630 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 455 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
already fallen in parts of the area.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
parts of the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mcleansboro, Dahlgren, Broughton, Macedonia, and Belle Prairie
City.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
